_readme: error = fails CI. warn = printed only. Matching is case-insensitive over src/, docs/, documentation/, help-center/, api-reference/, home/ and README.md (.ts .tsx .md .mts). Add a rule whenever a correction is made, so the same error cannot return.

errors.fix: Say what is checked: 'each dataset has a published checksum so you can confirm your copy matches the release.'
Only show a checksum state that was actually computed; otherwise remove.
Use a descriptive subtitle, e.g. 'An interactive atlas of geography, indicators and historical trade flows'.
State that indicators are a curated snapshot with per-value status flags.
Use 1514–1866 for voyages; 1501–1866 only for demographic estimates.
The app has 8 thematic pillars (see research/facts.json).
Remove ISSN references; use the universal DOI (https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.34065711).

warnings.fix: Cut, or give the comparison that makes it true.
Use 'current best', 'consistent with', or name the limit.
Say what can be reproduced, and how.

codePatterns.message: Values back-filled by scaling a 2024 figure must not be presented as observed. Tag them status:'derived' (or remove) and cite the rule in notes.
